system.description:
Grit or Wit; 2 Pierce; Close (5 ft). Vampire Slayer: after a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower, roll a CR 2 Luck Check; on a success it dies outright.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.137
system.summary: Grit or Wit; 2 Pierce; Close (5 ft). Vampire Slayer: after a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower, roll a CR 2 Luck Check; on a success it dies outright.

automation.note: Vampire Slayer: if this was a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower, keep it targeted, post this weapon to chat and roll its CR 2 Luck Check. On a success the enemy is slain instantly.

automation.label: Vampire Slayer (after a Critical Hit on a Vampyric enemy of CR 2 or lower)
automation.onSuccess: The targeted enemy is slain instantly.
